As Apple (AAPL) Share Value Declined, Shareholder St Johns Investment Management Company Has Decreased Position by $415,233; Warren Averett Asset Management Increases Position in At&T (T)
April 26, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
St Johns Investment Management Company Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc sold 2,457 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,397 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.96M, down from 25,854 at the end of the previous reported quarter. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $835.39 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.60% or $0.99 during the last trading session, reaching $164.64. About 3.41M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Warren Averett Asset Management Llc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 33.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Warren Averett Asset Management Llc bought 13,499 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 53,390 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.08 million, up from 39,891 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Warren Averett Asset Management Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $216.98B market cap company. The stock decreased 5.10% or $1.79 during the last trading session, reaching $33.41. About 18.79 million shares traded. AT&T Inc.
